# FitCheck – Copilot Instructions

This is a **Vite + React + TypeScript** outfit builder web app.

- Clothing catalog data lives in `src/data/catalog.ts`
- Main app logic and UI is in `src/App.tsx`
- Styles are in `src/App.css` (dark theme, CSS variables)
- Categories: shoes, tshirt, pants, jacket, hat, accessory
- Each item has a store, brand, price, emoji, color, and tags
- Users can filter by category/store, search, pick one item per category, and save outfits
